# signoz_role (Data Source)

Reads a single role by `id` or by unique `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "signoz_role" "viewer_plus" {
  name = "terraform-viewer-plus"
}

output "role_id" {
  value = data.signoz_role.viewer_plus.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Object UUID. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set for lookup.
- `name` (String) Object name (unique within the organization for that resource type). Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set for lookup.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when the object was created. Read-only.
- `description` (String) Role description. Default: omitted (empty string). This is the only field updated on apply after create.
- `org_id` (String) Organization UUID. Read-only.
- `type` (String) Role type from the API. Read-only. Valid values: `custom`, `managed`.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when the object was last updated. Read-only.
